BRACE 2/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Quads
SECONDARY
Glutes, Hamstrings

Instructions

Preparation: Sit against the back pad and hold the side handles. Place both feet on the plate; keep heels supported. Control the return and stop before your back rounds.

1

Set both feet flat on the plate.

2

Brace; keep your back against the pad.

3

Push the plate away through both feet.

4

Keep knees soft at the finish.

5

Bend hips and knees under control.

6

Keep your heels down before pressing again.

Watch out

Keep your back supported and press through both feet without snapping your knees straight.

COMMON MISTAKES

Rounding the lower back off the pad.
Lifting the heels off the plate.
Snapping the knees straight.
